sourceIds.title: Source ids
sourceIds.description: Ids from src/ingest/sources.ts. Defaults to the two sources that return 403 to datacenter IPs.

limit.title: Pages per source
limit.description: Cap pages per source, sampled evenly across the sitemap. Leave empty for the full back catalogue. Start small — residential proxy traffic is metered.

delayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
delayMs.description: Per-host delay. Not politeness theatre: hosts silently truncate paginated responses when hit too fast, without erroring.
